narrative.overview: A light, Korean-first task interface. Green ink stamps carry the distinctive festival character; navigation, forms, and operator tools remain compact and familiar. The approved direction is bright rather than dark or muted beige.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces, mint actions, green records, blue information, and yellow claimable rewards.
Flat sections and readable lists, with cards reserved for individual coupons and focused tools.
Operating state, visit state, completed rating, and voucher issuance remain visually distinct.

rules.name: The Independent State Rule
rules.body: A completed visit never hides a paused booth or implies a voucher was issued.

dos: Do preserve a bright fixed-light palette and comfortable Korean reading sizes.
Do distinguish visit completion, required rating, operating status, and voucher state.
Do use mint for ordinary voucher navigation and yellow for a confirmed reward action.
Do keep real authorization, errors, loading, and retry behavior intact when changing visuals.
donts: Don't ship synthetic proposal data or mock operator actions as real features.
Don't reintroduce crowded dashboards, nested cards, crowding indicators, or event creation.
Don't carry legacy amber selected-star styling into new screens.
